notes.title: Future Of Colonize!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all our fans, first of all, we want to thank you for the successful first month of the game Colonize Prologue, for your support, and ideas that you write to us every day. Don't worry, we read everything even if we don't have time to write off or react, unfortunately, we also read a lot of bad reviews.

And that's exactly what we want to comment on today and the future of Colonize. We needed a couple of weeks to plan and go through all your ideas, good and bad reviews, and where we want to go with the game, as creators.

We mainly want to focus on completing the game Colonize as a whole, so that the game works reliably and without bugs. Therefore, we have to dig through a lot of code, a lot of old code, and unfortunately, that does not allow us to further update the game Colonize Prologue.

At one point we had to split these projects but we hoped it would be later, but we simply have no choice. Therefore, we will release a few Colonize Prologue updates and then move on to the full development of the full Colonize game so that we are happy with it, as we don't have much time left.

We hope you are not disappointed, Colonize Prologue, is a demo designed to find out its potential, and interest in a given type of game and theme. 

Since we are basically only 2 developers, the main purpose was to convince investors about this project, so we chose this path, to release a small portion of the game. Fortunately, it paid off for us and our partner, Creative Forge Games, continues with us!

notes.title: Colonize Prologue Update #4
notes.notes:
Hello colonizer!

Changes:

[list]
[*] Auto Harvest! No need to click on the Harvest button
[*] Crops grow slower
[*] Farm is no longer called Wheat Field
[*] No longer spending money on livestock when the farm is full
[*] Farm is closing by temperature - 7°C closes 15°C opens
[*] No F word anymore
[*] Fixed Icons position, was wrong since the last update

[/list]

If you are not happy with the changes, go to Discord and tell us more what you wish for!

notes.title: Colonize Prologue update #2
notes.notes:
Hello Colonizers!

A lot of bug fixes and changes!

[*] Added animations of harvesting/gathering meat

[*] Health is more dynamic

[/list]

Known issues:

The problem with settings to low can change the resolution settings and causes problems with GUI - working on fixing this one! 

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Colonize Prologue - first release
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Colonizer!

We are excited to share our years of effort with you, it's a start of a new journey and creating a community so we can build and improve this game together.

Even if it is released, it's not finished, we are aware of this one. So we are begging you to be patient with all the bugs you will encounter. Colonize Prologue is our intro to PC game development, STEAM, and overall creating a community. 

Rembrosoft is mainly two guys, two brothers, we cannot compete with big studios and we are aware of that, but trying to make this experience the best as possible. 

So what now? Please write us all bugs/suggestions or ideas on our Discord Server - https://discord.com/invite/uUEbeKjBNJ

That's all guys! Hope you will have fun!
